title: Kubrick on the 2001 monolith

tellings.quote: 2001's director Stanley kubric said in a 1969 interview that interpreting the monolith as an alien artifact is the movie's most superficial interpretation

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, notes that the film director Stanley Kubrick said in a 1969 interview that seeing the monolith in his film 2001: A Space Odyssey, a tall black slab left by unseen beings, as just an alien artifact was the movie's most shallow reading. Michels mentions Arthur C. Clarke, who wrote the novel version, and brings the quote into a talk on UFOs and religion to suggest the deeper meaning is spiritual.
